statement: ∀ (s : ℝ) (f : KdVPlan.Coeff) (k : ℤ), ‖(KdVPlan.weight (s/2) k : ℂ) * f k‖^2 = KdVPlan.weight s k * ‖f k‖^2 ∧ KdVPlan.weight s k * ‖(KdVPlan.weight (-s/2) k : ℂ) * f k‖^2 = ‖f k‖^2 ∧ (KdVPlan.weight (-s/2) k : ℂ) * ((KdVPlan.weight (s/2) k : ℂ) * f k) = f k
proof:
intro s f k
have hw := yui_aux_0001 T gamma R s k
have hn := (yui_aux_0001 T gamma R (-s) k).1.le
have hp : 0 ≤ KdVPlan.weight (-s/2) k := (yui_aux_0001 T gamma R (-s/2) k).1.le
have hp' : 0 ≤ KdVPlan.weight (s/2) k := (yui_aux_0001 T gamma R (s/2) k).1.le
refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
· rw [norm_mul, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg hp', mul_pow, hw.2.2.2]
· rw [norm_mul, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg hp, mul_pow, ← mul_assoc, hw.2.2.1, one_mul]
· rw [← mul_assoc, ← Complex.ofReal_mul, hw.2.1]
  simp
